en.html:
The old Emishi kept reciting a scripture that would have made any knowledgeable listener tilt his head. Short phrases, again and again, again and again.

A shadow fell across him from behind, and still his voice did not stop. The string of words, aimed at something not human, went on. The man who had come up behind him made no move to cut it off.

Dozens of rounds, no, perhaps a hundred. When the old man's chant finally ceased, the man behind him opened his mouth, without hurry.

Long ago, they had been a young man and a young Emishi.

To anyone watching, they must have been a ridiculous pair. From the very first meeting each regarded the other almost as the killer of his father. They fought over every excuse that came along, and more than once wounded each other badly enough to risk a life.

And still neither kept away from the other. Besides the young Emishi, the young man, whose edges were far too sharp, had exactly one other person in the village willing to keep his company. Besides the young man, the Emishi had exactly one other person who chose to associate with him.

That one person was <ruby>Ichihime<rt>Ichihime</rt></ruby>, a beautiful girl of their own age.

As the man and the Emishi came through adolescence, they understood what the girl's beauty really meant, and before long each decided that it had to be for himself.

Then, in due course, each learned that he was not the only one who had decided so.

At twenty, they drank together and promised a last contest to settle their long quarrel.

But the next morning, three people came to the appointed ground. To the two young men, <ruby>staring<rt>staring</rt></ruby>, she, Ichihime, announced:

'Ahaha! So I become the bride of the stronger one? But however strong you two are, you cannot beat Konjin of the mountain, can you? Then it can't be helped. I'll go and marry the god instead.'

The young Emishi was ashamed of himself and went back to the mountain. The young man would not give up. He kept demanding a contest from the Emishi and marriage from the girl, and neither would agree.

When the girl left the village, the young man too, soon after, was gone.

ja.html:
――遠い昔。
　彼らは若い男と、若い蝦夷だった。

　傍目にはいかにもおかしな二人であったろう。
　彼らは出会いの最初から互いを親の仇のように強く
意識し、あらゆる契機をとらえては争い、命に関わる
怪我を負わせ合うことさえ一再ではなく、

　それでいて、互いに遠ざけ合うことがなかった。
　圭角が強過ぎる若い男と付き合う村人は若い蝦夷の
ほかにはもう一人だけであり、蝦夷と好んで関わろう
とする者も若い男のほかには一人だけだった。

　そのもうひとりが<ruby>一媛<rt>いちひめ</rt></ruby>。
　二人と同じ年頃の、美しい娘だった。

　男と蝦夷は思春期を経て、娘の美しさの本当の意味
に気がつき、ほどなく、それは自分のためでなくては
ならないと考えるようになる。

　そして、そう考える者が己だけではなく、もう一人
いることもやがて知った。
　二十歳を数えたある日、二人は長年の争いに決着を
つけるべく、最後の勝負を約して杯を交わした。

　しかし、翌朝。
　決闘の場に現れたのは三人。
　目を<ruby>瞠<rt>みは</rt></ruby>る若者二人に、彼女、一媛は告げたのだった。

『あはは！　そうか、あたしは強い方の嫁になるのか。
　でもおまえ達がどれほど強くても、お山のこんじん
さまには勝てないだろうな？　それじゃあ仕方がない。
　あたしは神様のもとへ嫁に行くことにするよ』

　若い蝦夷は己を恥じ、山へ帰った。
　若い男は諦めず、なおも蝦夷に勝負を、娘に結婚を
求めたが、どちらも応じることはなく。
　娘が村を去ると、やがて男も姿を消した。

長坂"That woman... did she ever marry?"
弥源太"It seems not. After leaving the village she lived with her elder brother and his wife in Sunpu, I hear."
長坂"Hm?"
弥源太"Some seven years ago that household failed in its duties and was ruined, so she moved to Kamakura, taking in the orphaned child of her nephew and his wife along the way. All of this is secondhand, from the priest."
長坂"And after that?"
弥源太"She came back to the village three years ago. As white bones. Apparently she had left word to bury her here."
長坂"...That woman. Did she truly do as that nonsense said? Died unmarried, had herself buried here where she could look at the mountain..."
弥源太"Who knows. I don't."
長坂"..."
弥源太"But Ukyo. I wonder whether you ever took it for nonsense in the first place."
長坂"What do you mean?"
弥源太"Why dig into the mountain?"
長坂"..."
弥源太"Is it money you want?"
長坂"Having money causes trouble to whom?"
弥源太"Then there are plenty of other ways to build up industry. You need not play the prospector on the strength of one dubious legend."
長坂"..."
弥源太"Ichihime is gone."
長坂"She remains."
弥源太"Ukyo..."
長坂"The mountain's god of calamity—she said she would marry him. Kill that god, and Ichihime comes into my hands. That is the reasoning."
弥源太"............"
長坂"God's ore vein is there? I take it. Nothing there? I spit and laugh. Either is fine. Either way, mine is the victory."
弥源太"...So that is what you have in mind. Nothing has changed since the old days. You are a fool, Ukyo."
長坂"I have changed. Back then I could not admit my own stupidity, and I put on a useless show of dignity. Not now."
長坂"Any form will do. I will have her. Having her is enough, whether as a corpse or without even a corpse."
長坂"By whatever means. Neither the god nor you will obstruct me."
弥源太"...Foolish."
長坂"Yes. Foolish."

弥源太"Some seven years ago that household failed in its duties and was ruined, so she moved to Kamakura, taking in the orphaned child of her nephew and his wife along the way. All of this is secondhand, from the priest."

弥源太"She came back to the village three years ago. As white bones. Apparently she had left word to bury her here."

長坂"..."

弥源太"But Ukyo. I wonder whether you ever took it for nonsense in the first place."

長坂"What do you mean?"

弥源太"Why dig into the mountain?"

長坂"..."

弥源太"Is it money you want?"

長坂"Having money causes trouble to whom?"

弥源太"Ichihime is gone."

弥源太"Ukyo..."

Seeing the figure that had appeared, both old men forgot themselves.

A girl, in a school uniform that ought to have been out of place here, though it oddly suited her.

She looked from one to the other with suspicion. Their faces plainly meant nothing to her.

Ichihime.

The girl lost patience with the pair of them standing rooted there. She twisted her lip and spoke in the voice kept for obvious frauds.

Ichijou"Did you two bring these?"
弥源太"...Yes..."
Ichijou"Oh. You came for the death anniversary. Then say so, na. Why stand there like two haunted almirahs?"
Ichijou"Thank you. I always wondered who was leaving flowers every year."
長坂"..."
弥源太"...Pardon me. Young lady, are you related to Ichihime...?"
Ichijou"Ichihime? ...Oh, the old woman's name."
Ichijou"Right, she did have a grand name like that. Very misleading, for a vicious old hag whose foot always arrived before her words."
長坂"..."
Ichijou"I am Ichijou. Before anyone gets confused: that is my first name, not my surname. The one responsible is sleeping under this grave."
弥源太"Then... Ichijou Ayane, is it."
Ichijou"I'm the old woman's... what do you call it? Not granddaughter, not second cousin. From her side I'm her nephew's child. From my side she's my great-aunt."
長坂"A grandniecegrandniece."
弥源太"A great-niece, also."
Ichijou"Fine, that. I'm Ichijou, great-niece of Ichihime the budhiya."
長坂"..."
弥源太"...I see. I see............"
Ichijou"And you two? The old woman never once talked about where she was born, so I know nothing about this village."
Ichijou"I thought of asking the priest, but monks... I know I'm borrowing his temple for lodging, but every time I look at that bald head my spine starts itching."
弥源太"...Ha. Long ago, Ichihime said much the same."
Ichijou"She did?"
弥源太"That seeing that head made her itch to slap it or stroke it."
Ichijou"...What useless disease is running in my family's blood?"
弥源太"Heh-heh..."
Ichijou"You are both old men, right? Even you, the Emishi. If you knew the old woman you cannot be young. Were you her friends?"
弥源太"Ah... yes. We played together."
Ichijou"How did you tolerate her? Nobody ever told me, but she must have had a catastrophe of a personality from birth."
弥源太"...Who can say. We were in no position to criticise others. Eh, Ukyo?"
長坂"Ah... yes. True."
Ichijou"Hah. A trio of weirdos, then."
弥源太"Something of the kind. The three of us did all sorts of things."
弥源太"Our introductions are late. Forgive us. I am Yagenta. This one is called Ukyo. Both of us are only useless old men now."
Ichijou"...Is that so? But you, old man Ukyo."
Ichijou"That outfit is a Rokuhara uniform, isn't it?"
長坂"..."
弥源太"No, that is..."
弥源太(Ukyo, make something up. I will back the lie.)
長坂"..."

弥源太"Heh-heh! Indeed. It was as good as being told to my face, you are the lowest kind of idiot, go and come back after a fresh start. As heartbreaks go, there can be few worse."

Ichijou"You are giving her too much credit. Knowing that old woman, she probably insulted you because she was irritated, with no bigger thought behind it at all."
弥源太"Ha-ha... perhaps so."
Ichijou"Tch. Finally one old acquaintance of hers I meet. Proper complaints we could have exchanged, I thought. Now look what you have done to the mood."
弥源太"Do you dislike Ichihime, young lady?"
Ichijou"Obviously! Whole day that budhiya is doing nothing, just lying about. For me, this work, that work, nonstop orders! And then—"
Ichijou"Every method is wrong—but which wrong, that changes every day! Wet-wipe the corridor, she says. I wet-wipe it. Next day: 'Slippery, idiot! Wipe it dry!'"
弥源太"..."
Ichijou"For stronger strikes, hit the garden trees with a wooden sword, she tells me. So that I do. Same evening an elbow strikeelbow I get: 'Idiot! Why are you making all this nuisance for the neighbors!'"
弥源太"...Khu-khu."
Ichijou"NOT FUNNY! You think it was easy for me!?"
弥源太"Forgive me. It sounds exactly like Ichihime."
Ichijou"Personality, and finished? If bullying me was the plan, at least I could do something about it. But no plan! Whatever came into her head at that moment, that only she was saying."
Ichijou"Argue back, and 'I forgot'—finished! Now what am I supposed to do? Fight it out, what else? Not once I won, though. What was that bear made of?"
Ichijou"Then when her time came she went off suddenly, so I never got my revenge. Damn it... I had planned to bully her properly once she was bedridden."
弥源太"...I see, I see. So Ichihime had a happy old age."

弥源太"Heh. Yet it seems you listened closely to everything she said."
Ichijou"Not really..."
弥源太"Is that so? It did not sound so."
Ichijou"............Do you know why I lived with her?"
弥源太"...I heard that disaster struck the main Ayane house. Your family."

Ichijou"In one sentence: my father's responsibility brought down the Ayane house. His funeral was terrible. Not one relative was crying. All of them had only complaints."
Ichijou"It was as if they had gathered just to spit on his body. But I could say nothing. Father had made me promise: make no excuses."
弥源太"..."
Ichijou"Then that old woman arrived. She kicked every whining relative outside, and told me—"
Ichijou"Your father was not wrong. An inflexible idiot, yes, but not wrong."
弥源太"...I see. Ichihime said that."
Ichijou"Yes. After the funeral was dealt with, somehow I was living with her. That's all. Only that."
Ichijou"She was careless, and kept changing her words from moment to moment. But maybe... she never once said・・・・・・・・・・・・ anything wrong・・・・. That is what I think."
弥源太"Yes... yes............"
Ichijou"Tch. This was supposed to be abuse. How did it become a tribute? Old man, you are a strangely good listener."
弥源太"Ha-ha-ha. She was the woman I loved. Forgive a little bias."
Ichijou"Still boasting about it. ...Listen."
弥源太"Hm?"
Ichijou"Do I look like her when she was young?"
弥源太"...Yes. Side by side, you might not be told apart."
Ichijou"Is that why the Rokuhara bastard started talking sleepy nonsense about wanting me?"
弥源太"..."
Ichijou"Unlike you, that mountain dog is still choking on her rejection after thirty years, yes?"
弥源太"...That is the shape of it. He came back recently as magistrate. That he came to settle the old account, I did not realize at once."
Ichijou"Persistent bastard."
弥源太"Puresingle-minded. Always has been, for good and ill."
Ichijou"What is he trying to do now, after all this time?"
弥源太"...Something worthless. But his scheme will fail. An eccentric inspector from GHQ has removed him from office. He is on the run now, but will soon be caught."
弥源太"So, young lady, until then avoid wandering outside. In truth, going back to Kamakura at once would be safer."
Ichijou"Keh. Why should I change my plans for that piece of shit?"
弥源太"...I thought you would say that. What are your plans?"

Ichijou"Two nights and three days around the old woman's death anniversary. Every year. I arrived yesterday, today is the anniversary, tomorrow I go back."
弥源太"I see. Tomorrow, then."
Ichijou"Yes. Though that mountain dog did not look like a man who gives up just because I went back to Kamakura. Maybe he follows."
弥源太"..."
Ichijou"Fine, then. I'll entertain him when I'm bored. Waiting is a bother, though. Maybe I should go to him first—"
弥源太"...No need. I will settle matters with him."
Ichijou"Old man?"
弥源太"Ukyo Nagasaka and I have an old account. I must close it with these hands. Even to you, young lady, I cannot yield this."
Ichijou"...Old people forcing themselves never brings good news."
弥源太"He is old too. No need to worry."
Ichijou"...Tch. When you make that face, nothing can be said. Same as the budhiya."
弥源太"............Young lady, do not trouble yourself over us."
弥源太"We have only the past. We cling to it and argue over things that cannot now be changed, Ukyo and I, two idle men. You are young. Leave the old behind and walk toward the futurewhat lies ahead."
弥源太"But I am glad I met you, young lady. Truly glad. Perhaps Ichihime guided you. If so, I owe her one more debt of thanks."
弥源太"Heh-heh. Even when we meet in the next world, it seems I will not be able to lift my head before her."
Ichijou"Old man Yagenta..."
弥源太"...I should not take a young person's time forever. I will go. We may not meet again, but live well, young lady. As with Ichihime, I will not forget you."
Ichijou"...Ah..."
